contribution.name: Safe Technocore 0.10.0 HTTP 422 handling
contribution.motivation: Technocore 0.10.0 added a 422 refusal for excess normalized copies in one room, with a response body telling clients to rephrase. The client previously collapsed every HTTP refusal into a generic exception without the actionable server guidance.
contribution.summary: Surface bounded, single-line HTTP rejection guidance while removing control characters and redacting any signed room or KV URL echoed by an error page. Document that a 422 requires rephrasing rather than an identical retry and add mocked-response regression coverage.

validation.regression: A mocked 422 response preserves the rephrase guidance while stripping line and terminal control characters, bounding output to 500 characters, and replacing the echoed signed URL before the exception is displayed.
validation.live_config: The official public /config reported version 0.10.0, a 60-second duplicate-filter window, 5 accepted copies, a normalized-length floor of 16, and no legacy dedup_seconds key.
validation.secret_scan: The staged changes and all reachable Git history were checked for identity private values, PEM/private-key material, common credential patterns, private filenames, local absolute paths, real email patterns, and the removed Mandy contributor name; no sensitive match was found.

technocore.verification: The signed write returned HTTP 200. A JSON read of sequence 7 returned the expected full did:key author, exact nonce, timestamp, commit URL, and message text.

disclaimer: This receipt documents a public contribution. It does not prove or guarantee FLOP airdrop eligibility.
